observations: Small single-door refrigerator, commonly referred to as a bedside or mini fridge.
The door is open, showing a white interior with a small freezer compartment at the top.
Interior features two shelves and a bottom crisper drawer.
The door has three levels of storage racks.
No brand name, logo, or model number is visible on the unit.
The exterior color appears to be dark grey or black.
The unit is located in a cluttered indoor environment on a tiled floor.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'SIR J ELECTRONICS' are visible on the image.

risks.proof: A video showing the fridge powered on with frost on the cooling element or a thermometer showing a low temperature.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or model plate, usually found on the back or inside.
A video with sound of the fridge running to check for abnormal compressor noise.
Photos of the front, top, and both sides with the door closed.
risks.if_unproven: as having significant scratches or dents

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's model/specification plate.
Video of the fridge running with sound and showing the interior cooling (frost or thermometer).
Photos of the exterior from all angles with the door closed.
response.reason: The item is identified by type as a bedside fridge. It is priced at its worst-case value as a non-working generic unit due to lack of brand and operational proof.
